goal_native: Run an everyday wash with the Eco 50° program
goal_en: Run an everyday wash with the Eco 50° program
intro_native: This is a Siemens iQ500 built-in dishwasher. Its buttons are along the top edge of the door. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.
intro_en: This is a Siemens iQ500 built-in dishwasher. Its buttons are along the top edge of the door. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.

buttons.function_native: Turns the dishwasher on and off.
buttons.function_en: Turns the dishwasher on and off.

buttons.function_native: For pots and pans with heavy or burnt-on food.
buttons.function_en: For pots and pans with heavy or burnt-on food.

buttons.function_native: Senses how dirty the load is and adjusts the wash. Good for mixed loads.
buttons.function_en: Senses how dirty the load is and adjusts the wash. Good for mixed loads.

buttons.function_native: Everyday program that uses the least energy and water. It takes the longest.
buttons.function_en: Everyday program that uses the least energy and water. It takes the longest.

buttons.function_native: Extra-quiet wash, for example at night.
buttons.function_en: Extra-quiet wash, for example at night.

buttons.function_native: Gentle wash for glasses with light dirt.
buttons.function_en: Gentle wash for glasses with light dirt.

buttons.function_native: Full wash and dry in about one hour.
buttons.function_en: Full wash and dry in about one hour.

buttons.function_native: Short wash for lightly dirty dishes.
buttons.function_en: Short wash for lightly dirty dishes.

buttons.function_native: Quick cold rinse to hold dishes until a full wash. Hold for 3 seconds to open the settings.
buttons.function_en: Quick cold rinse to hold dishes until a full wash. Hold for 3 seconds to open the settings.

buttons.function_native: Sets the wash to start later.
buttons.function_en: Sets the wash to start later.

buttons.function_native: Stronger, hotter spray in the lower basket only, for pots.
buttons.function_en: Stronger, hotter spray in the lower basket only, for pots.

buttons.function_native: Lights up when rinse aid is low.
buttons.function_en: Lights up when rinse aid is low.

buttons.function_native: Lights up when dishwasher salt needs refilling.
buttons.function_en: Lights up when dishwasher salt needs refilling.

buttons.function_native: Probably reminds you to run a cleaning cycle.
buttons.function_en: Probably reminds you to run a cleaning cycle.

buttons.function_native: Short press starts the wash. Hold for 3 seconds to cancel.
buttons.function_en: Short press starts the wash. Hold for 3 seconds to cancel.

steps.narration_native: First, scrape off leftover food. You don't need to rinse. Put the dishes in the baskets and make sure the spray arms can spin freely.
steps.narration_en: First, scrape off leftover food. You don't need to rinse. Put the dishes in the baskets and make sure the spray arms can spin freely.

steps.narration_native: Find the little detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in a tab or powder, then close its lid.
steps.narration_en: Find the little detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in a tab or powder, then close its lid.

steps.narration_native: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. Just right of the Siemens name is a round power symbol. Press it to turn the machine on.
steps.narration_en: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. Just right of the Siemens name is a round power symbol. Press it to turn the machine on.

steps.narration_native: Now choose a program. For everyday dishes, press the button labelled Eco, with 50 degrees under it. It's the third program from the left.
steps.narration_en: Now choose a program. For everyday dishes, press the button labelled Eco, with 50 degrees under it. It's the third program from the left.

steps.narration_native: On the right side of the strip, find the word Start. Press it once, briefly.
steps.narration_en: On the right side of the strip, find the word Start. Press it once, briefly.

steps.narration_native: Close the door within a few seconds. The wash only runs with the door shut. Now just let it do its work.
steps.narration_en: Close the door within a few seconds. The wash only runs with the door shut. Now just let it do its work.

tips.native: Not sure which program to use? Choose Auto. For pots with dried-on food, choose Intensive 70°.
tips.en: Not sure which program to use? Choose Auto. For pots with dried-on food, choose Intensive 70°.

tips.native: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 seconds, then close the door. The water drains in about a minute.
tips.en: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 seconds, then close the door. The water drains in about a minute.

tips.native: When the bottle light is on, refill rinse aid. When the wavy-lines light is on, refill dishwasher salt.
tips.en: When the bottle light is on, refill rinse aid. When the wavy-lines light is on, refill dishwasher salt.

tips.native: Unload the lower basket first, so drips from the top don't land on clean dishes.
tips.en: Unload the lower basket first, so drips from the top don't land on clean dishes.

tips.native: Clean the filter at the bottom of the machine regularly.
tips.en: Clean the filter at the bottom of the machine regularly.

warnings.native: Use only dishwasher salt, never table salt. Wipe up spills and run a program right after refilling.
warnings.en: Use only dishwasher salt, never table salt. Wipe up spills and run a program right after refilling.

warnings.native: Detergent is harmful. Keep it away from children.
warnings.en: Detergent is harmful. Keep it away from children.

warnings.native: Don't open the door during a wash. Hot steam can come out.
warnings.en: Don't open the door during a wash. Hot steam can come out.

warnings.native: Put knives in point-down or in the cutlery drawer.
warnings.en: Put knives in point-down or in the cutlery drawer.

closing_native: Well done! Your dishes are washing. When it finishes, let them cool for a few minutes before you unload.
closing_en: Well done! Your dishes are washing. When it finishes, let them cool for a few minutes before you unload.
